blurb: Top of the Line Charters offers inshore and near shore fishing adventures with professional captains who provide all fishing tackle and licensing. They also offer island hopping lunch charters to Daufuskie Island with drinks and lunch at a waterfront café. Sunset cruises provide a scenic experience with nonalcoholic drinks and music, or guests can bring their own refreshments.
